description_en: Binds an external identity provider to a specified workspace for single sign-on and organization member synchronization. Each workspace can be bound to at most one external identity provider. The binding is an asynchronous operation. After the API returns, you can track the progress by querying the status through GetIdentityProvider
description_zh: 为指定工作空间绑定外部身份提供商，用于工作空间用户的单点登录和组织成员同步。每个工作空间最多绑定一个外部身份提供商。绑定为异步操作，接口返回后可通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询 status 跟踪进展
name: CreateIdentityProvider

fields.help_en: The type of the external identity provider. Valid values: DingTalk, Feishu
fields.help_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu
fields.name: identity_provider_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether workspace users are allowed to log on through this external identity provider
fields.help_zh: 是否允许工作空间用户通过该外部身份提供商登录
fields.name: login_enabled

fields.help_en: The App ID of the Lark application. This parameter is required when the binding type is Feishu
fields.help_zh: 飞书应用的 App ID。绑定类型为 Feishu 时必填
fields.name: app_id

fields.help_en: The AppKey of the DingTalk application. This parameter is required when the binding type is DingTalk
fields.help_zh: 钉钉应用的 AppKey。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填
fields.name: app_key

fields.help_en: Required. The secret of the external identity provider application. This parameter is used only for write operations. The query API does not return this field
fields.help_zh: 必填。外部身份提供商应用的密钥。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: app_secret

fields.help_en: The CorpId of the DingTalk enterprise. This parameter is required when the binding type is DingTalk
fields.help_zh: 钉钉企业的 CorpId。绑定类型为 DingTalk 时必填
fields.name: corp_id

fields.help_en: The data encryption key for event subscription. The value must be the same as the one configured in the external identity provider application. This parameter is used only for write operations. The query API does not return this field
fields.help_zh: 事件订阅的数据加密密钥，取值与外部身份提供商应用中配置的一致。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: encrypt_key

fields.help_en: The verification token for event subscription. The value must be the same as the one configured in the external identity provider application. This parameter is used only for write operations. The query API does not return this field
fields.help_zh: 事件订阅的校验令牌，取值与外部身份提供商应用中配置的一致。仅用于写入，查询接口不返回该字段
fields.name: verification_token

fields.help_en: The application configuration of the external identity provider. When binding DingTalk, you must provide appKey, appSecret, and corpId. When binding Lark, you must provide appId and appSecret
fields.help_zh: 外部身份提供商的应用配置。绑定 DingTalk 时需要提供 appKey、appSecret 和 corpId，绑定 Feishu 时需要提供 appId 和 appSecret
fields.name: metadata

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable organization member synchronization. After this feature is enabled, the external identity provider synchronizes organization members as workspace users
fields.help_zh: 是否开启组织成员同步。开启后由该外部身份提供商同步组织成员为工作空间用户
fields.name: sync_enabled

parameters.help_en: The request body for binding an external identity provider
parameters.help_zh: 绑定外部身份提供商的请求内容
parameters.name: body

data.description_en: The binding information of the external identity provider
data.description_zh: 外部身份提供商的绑定信息

identityProviderType.description_en: The type of the external identity provider. Valid values: DingTalk, Feishu
identityProviderType.description_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu

loginEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether workspace users are allowed to log on through this external identity provider
loginEnabled.description_zh: 是否允许工作空间用户通过该外部身份提供商登录

status.description_en:
The binding status. Valid values:
CONFIGURED: The configuration has been accepted and is waiting for user pool provisioning.
SYNCING: Organization members are being synchronized.
SYNCED: Organization member synchronization is complete.
READY: The binding is active.
SYNC_FAILED: Organization member synchronization failed.
UPDATING: The configuration is being updated.
UPDATE_FAILED: The configuration update failed.
DISCONNECTING: The binding is being removed.
DISCONNECT_FAILED: The unbinding failed
status.description_zh: 绑定状态。可选值：CONFIGURED（配置已受理，等待开通用户池）、SYNCING（正在同步组织成员）、SYNCED（组织成员同步完成）、READY（绑定已生效）、SYNC_FAILED（组织成员同步失败）、UPDATING（正在更新配置）、UPDATE_FAILED（更新配置失败）、DISCONNECTING（正在解绑）、DISCONNECT_FAILED（解绑失败）

syncEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to enable organization member synchronization. After this feature is enabled, the external identity provider synchronizes organization members as workspace users
syncEnabled.description_zh: 是否开启组织成员同步。开启后由该外部身份提供商同步组织成员为工作空间用户

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
